title: docs(agents): name a new package by its kind and freeze the plugin- prefix at its ten
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8MyE4m329ZuXhdkjK4apEQv)_
Fixes #29709

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AGENTS.md 角色表两行就地改写,写明新包按种类命名、`plugin-` 前缀冻结在现有十个;pm-dispatch 派发令加一行建包要求。
- 为什么改:ADR-0012 写的 `plugin-notification-push` 差点让推送通道成为孤例;仓里没有任何一句话说新包怎么起名、ADR 与仓内先例冲突时谁赢。
- 风险与回滚:只改规则文字,不改任何包、不改名;两文件行数净零。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`AGENTS.md` 的 `packages/services/**` 与 `packages/plugins/**` 两行;`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 派发节新增行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期 AGENTS.md 1050/1050、execution-duties.md 188/188 皆绿。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(AGENTS.md 属 Tier H,需维护者批准)。

## What changes

- `AGENTS.md` roles table, two rows rewritten in place (zero line growth, 1050 of the 1050-line ceiling):
  - `packages/services/**`: a new kernel-managed service (fills a `core-services` slot, registers a service, or holds transports/credentials) is `@objectstack/service-NAME` in `packages/services/service-NAME`. Plus the ADR-precedence sentence, which opens "For any new package, in this row or the one above": a package name in an ADR is a proposal; where the tree's precedent differs, the PR that creates the package follows the precedent and amends that ADR's status line in the same change. It sits in the row, so `docs/adr/` is untouched.
  - `packages/plugins/**`: a new package here is named by its kind (`embedder-*`, `knowledge-*`, …); drivers and connectors have their own directories (`packages/drivers/driver-*`, `packages/connectors/connector-*`); the `plugin-` prefix is frozen to the ten that carry it today and never coined again; none of the ten is renamed.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (派发 section), one line added after the "lists, paths, line numbers are read from the tree at dispatch" rule: an order that creates a package names the directory and the npm name, and the dev measures same-kind precedent before writing; the naming rule itself lives in the AGENTS.md roles table (not restated). 118 bytes, under the 120-byte line cap.
- Paid for under `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (execution-duties.md 188/188, headroom 0) by retiring one line restated elsewhere: 复核 section 「报告或复核见涉 cloud ⇒ 整卡 `Release:`+`pm:retriage` 转 cloud 车道,读点留卡;⛔ 不拆半边。」. Surviving home: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md` lines 44 (涉 cloud 即整卡归 cloud PM), 46 (⛔ 不拆半边等读数) and 47 (在飞卡见涉 cloud 即 `Release:`+`pm:retriage` 交分诊转 cloud 车道,已测读点留卡). No re-wrap was used as currency.
- Not changed: no package renamed or moved; no gate added (the gate is the `domain:devx` sibling card #29710, which freezes the same ten names).

## Why

Maintainer ruling, verbatim (project thread "Decide push channel package name", 2026-11-03): 「应该用 service-*，包括如何制定仓库规则，避免类似的问题」 (02:11:43Z) and 「plugin- 太笼统，是不是建议逐渐退役这个名字。」 (02:12:01Z). The ten `plugin-*` names are published, so the prefix is retired for new names only.

## Verification

Measured on `origin/main` c9636f1e before editing:

<details><summary>Packages under packages/services and packages/plugins (directory = npm name for all 32)</summary>

- services (18): `service-analytics`, `service-automation`, `service-cache`, `service-cluster`, `service-cluster-redis`, `service-datasource`, `service-i18n`, `service-job`, `service-knowledge`, `service-mailbox`, `service-messaging`, `service-package`, `service-print`, `service-queue`, `service-realtime`, `service-settings`, `service-sms`, `service-storage` (all `@objectstack/`).
- plugins (14): `embedder-openai`, `knowledge-memory`, `knowledge-ragflow`, `organizations`, and the ten `plugin-*`: `plugin-approvals`, `plugin-audit`, `plugin-auth`, `plugin-dev`, `plugin-email`, `plugin-hono-server`, `plugin-pinyin-search`, `plugin-security`, `plugin-sharing`, `plugin-webhooks`.
- `grep '"name": "@objectstack/plugin-'` over every `packages/**/package.json`: exactly those ten. Same set as #29710 measured on c9636f1e.
- AGENTS.md: 1050 lines, ceiling 1050 (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`); widest-table-row pin 768 B; the rewritten rows are 473 B (services) and 565 B (plugins) after the review round (fix commit `7187a55e`; gates re-ran on it, same 20 families, all exit 0).

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates: 20 of 20 derived by `dispatch-gates --commands` plus `pnpm lint`, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN</summary>

Run on the edit at base c9636f1e after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` (exit 0). `origin/main` 0eb97fa4 was then merged (it touches neither file) and `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` re-ran at exit 0.

`check:pm-skill-ratchet` readings: AGENTS.md 1050 lines (ceiling 1050), widest table row 768 B (pin 768); execution-duties.md 188 lines (ceiling 188).

</details>

Line budget: AGENTS.md 1050 → 1050; execution-duties.md 188 → 188 (+1 / −1). Not a `skills/**` change, so no whole-pack reading is owed. `skip-changeset`: `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/**` ship in no package's `files[]`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no identifiers added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is Chinese by the os-dev definition; the retired line is quoted verbatim)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
